rules: Replay has an immutable decision cutoff timestamp.
Evidence with as-of or publication time after cutoff is rejected.
Outcome windows begin after the decision cutoff.
The same packet, desk, committee and Chief Strategy contracts are used in replay.
Replay results are labeled historical and cannot masquerade as live evidence.
Agent Alpha receives only resolved post-cutoff outcomes.
Missing publication timestamps are excluded when point-in-time validity cannot be proven.
No replay component can execute a trade.
